key.name: selected-devices
key.summary: Selected Bluetooth adapter and device addresses
key.description: Stable addresses identifying saved monitoring targets.

key.name: monitoring-devices
key.description: Saved Bluetooth devices for which monitoring was explicitly enabled. The application resumes monitoring only while it is running and after BlueZ confirms that a saved, paired device is connected.

key.name: selected-device
key.description: Legacy setting retained for migrating older selections.

key.name: pane-position
key.description: Legacy absolute device pane width, retained for compatibility.

key.name: pane-fraction
key.summary: Device pane width as a proportion
key.description: Proportion of the main window width occupied by the device pane. The default splits the window evenly.

key.name: selected-only
key.description: Whether the device inventory hides devices outside the current draft selection.

key.name: desktop-alerts
key.description: Submit generic desktop notifications when new ANCS notifications arrive. Notification content is never included.
